name: 提花织锦缎防滑定制沙发坐垫款

shots.intent: 首屏一眼讲清「这是一套铺在自家沙发上的提花坐垫加抱枕」，用冷瓷青绿客厅与真实铺法让人代入，而不是卖沙发。
shots.textZone: 左上留白：柿橙小标签「{callout_1}」，主标题「{selling_point_1}」两行，其下一行细字「{callout_2}」，标题下 1px 双线

shots.intent: 干净的冷瓷棚拍单品图，一次看清坐垫厚度、分格与提花正面，负责搜索流量的一眼点击。
shots.textZone: 右下角一枚极小瓷白卡「{callout_1}」，画面内不加其它文字

shots.intent: 同机位俯视分屏放大「旧薄垫坐着往前滑、中间起皱、露出座面」的真实痛点，把定制尺寸加防滑底的需求逼出来。
shots.textZone: 顶部 #14403B 版面通栏主标「{selling_point_2}」带 1px 双线，两格底角各一枚细字标签「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」

shots.intent: 微距把提花纹样的织法起伏、缎面反光只落在花型内的真实质感做实，回答「面料到底厚不厚、显不显廉价」。
shots.textZone: 上方留白带：小标题「{selling_point_3}」与其下两枚细字标签「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」，虚线引线连到织纹

shots.intent: 正上方俯视把坐垫翻过来的防滑底面与边缘包法看清，直接回应「会不会往前滑、要不要天天整理」这个核心顾虑。
shots.textZone: 左侧细留白：竖排小标题「{selling_point_4}」与其下一枚细字标签「{callout_1}」，虚线引线连到底面

shots.intent: 镜头贴地的仰视把坐垫前缘受压后的形变与回弹轮廓做实，把坐感与塌陷疑虑落到看得见的证据上。
shots.textZone: 底部一枚细字标签「{callout_1}」，以虚线引线连到受压前缘

shots.intent: 实景把坐垫放回日常使用现场，并展示同一件垫子在沙发座面与靠背椅上都能铺，扩大可买人群。
shots.textZone: 右下角一枚细字标签「{callout_1}」，不加其它文字

shots.intent: 同一沙发的裸座面与加垫座面并排侧视，让厚度、服帖度与花色差自己看得见，替买家完成值不值的判断。
shots.textZone: 顶部主标「{selling_point_5}」，两格底角各一枚小标签「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」

shots.intent: 四宫格把可选花型与定制尺寸一次排开，让买家按自家沙发先认领图案和规格，替代源页杂牌款式混排。
shots.textZone: 顶部主标「{selling_point_6}」；四枚卡片底缘各一枚短标签「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」「{callout_4}」，不写具体花型名与尺寸数字

shots.intent: 把面料、底面、填充、规格四项看点与一张通用参数表摊开，用透明结构和诚实的定制说明降风险，而不是空洞承诺。
shots.textZone: 顶部主标「{selling_point_7}」；四枚六边形图标各配短标签「{callout_1}」至「{callout_4}」；下方参数表行名为品类／面料／底面／填充／规格五个通用词，数值一律为占位符「{callout_5}」

shots.intent: 复用首屏机位收口，把整页情绪落回自家客厅的座面，再给一个明确的量尺咨询动作。
shots.textZone: 下方三分之一瓷白留白：主标「{selling_point_1}」，其下一枚 3px 微圆角按钮，填色 #D9683C，内一行行动文案「{callout_1}」

style.backgroundSystem: only three fields are allowed across the set: a real reading corner with a deep sea-green painted wall #1B4A46 over a matte micro-cement floor #C2C5C1 with one undyed linen anchor sofa #C4C7BF; a seamless cool porcelain studio sweep #E3E7E4 with one brushed matte pine-green plinth #14403C and one clear acrylic riser for every packshot, underside and macro screen; and one flat deep pine-green graphic board #14403B carrying cool porcelain cards #F6F8F5 for comparison, process and specification layouts; every screen holds one clean copy zone, near-square tabs with a 3px micro-radius, one 1px persimmon #D9683C keyline and never busy decor
style.direction: material-led home-textile atelier commerce: macro-first fabric editorial on a cool porcelain and pine-green layout with a persimmon keyline, rather than airy nordic daylight living rooms, mid-tone charcoal copy bands or ink-wash warm zen interiors
style.iconSystem: 0.75pt hairline double-outline pictograms seated inside 2px-outline hexagonal frames with one solid persimmon #D9683C dot at the lower right corner, dotted-leader callouts ending in a filled 3px dot, and circled hairline numerals for steps, maximum five per screen; no filled discs, no square or round number chips, no circular monoline pictograms, no corner-bracket photo frames, no seal or stamp marks, no 3D badges
style.lightingSystem: even diffuse top-front light at 5000-5200K from a large overhead softbox tilted in from camera top-left, plus one narrow cool rim light from behind right that lifts the fabric edge off the background; a short dense contact shadow directly under the object, no long rakes, no window pools and no warm practical lamp; macro screens add one low grazing ribbon from camera left held at the same 5000K so the woven relief reads as topography; deliberately NOT a cool 6500K north-daylight wash, NOT a 4000-4300K mixed interior with ceiling downlight pools, and NOT a 3000K warm lantern grade
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent material-led home-textile atelier visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cool porcelain #E3E7E4, deep pine-green layout #14403B, graphite text #23292B and one persimmon accent #D9683C, with the product tones taken unchanged from the reference deep garnet jacquard face #6F2B3B and cool pale woven reverse #B9BEBB; cool-neutral grade; one narrow humanist condensed sans family for Chinese display headlines set over a 1px hairline double rule, the same family at regular weight for labels and in tabular figures for step numerals, all Chinese copy wrapped in 「」 and kept short, no serif, no brush calligraphy, no seal marks and no English uppercase kickers; backgrounds limited to a real reading corner with a deep sea-green painted wall #1B4A46 over a matte micro-cement floor #C2C5C1 with one undyed linen anchor sofa #C4C7BF, a seamless cool porcelain studio sweep #E3E7E4 with one brushed matte pine plinth #14403C and one clear acrylic riser, and one flat deep pine-green board #14403B carrying cool porcelain cards #F6F8F5, every screen holding one clean copy zone, near-square 3px micro-radius tabs and one 1px persimmon keyline; lighting always even diffuse top-front 5000-5200K from a large overhead softbox tilted in from camera top-left plus one narrow cool rim from behind right, short dense contact shadow directly under the object, one low grazing ribbon at 5000K on macro screens, never a 6500K daylight wash, never ceiling downlight pools, never a warm lamp practical; surface system of cool porcelain, matte micro-cement, brushed pine plinth, clear acrylic, matte porcelain cards and an undyed linen anchor sofa with a real weave, the product rendered exactly as supplied with satin sheen only inside the woven motif and no vinyl or leather gloss; icon system of 0.75pt hairline double-outline pictograms inside 2px hexagonal frames with one solid persimmon dot, dotted-leader callouts closing on a filled 3px dot and circled hairline numerals, maximum five per screen, no filled discs, no number chips, no circular monoline pictograms, no corner brackets and no seals; product presentation rules: the cushion is the product and every seat is scenery, one pad thickness, panel division, edge finish, motif scale, repeat direction and cover tone in every frame, matching pillow closure edge and motif placement unchanged, pad grounded with a real contact shadow and never floating, anchor sofa with identical seat cushion count, open rectangular arm profile, leg shape and pale upholstery colour in every frame plus one second real furnishing as scale anchor, corrected straight verticals, the slight 3/4 seated angle reused across scene screens; no color palette changes, no recoloured or re-scaled jacquard, no invented fabric weight, foam density or dimensions, no sofa presented as the product, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no brand marks, no QR codes, no membership badges, no prices, no policy or certificate claims, no people.
noDrift: no 6500K daylight wash, 4200K downlight pool or 3000K warm lantern grade replacing the 5000-5200K top-front key with its rear rim
no recoloured, re-woven or re-scaled jacquard motif and no invented pattern names
no invented fabric weight, fibre content, brocade grade, foam density, rebound figure, anti-slip particle count, wash claim, size or fit measurement
no sofa, chair or timber frame presented as the product or restyled between frames
no mixed fonts, no brush calligraphy and no seal marks
no random backgrounds and no rounded cards
no inconsistent lighting direction, no missing rim separation and no contradictory shadow lengths
no mismatched icon styles, no filled discs, no number chips, no corner brackets
no brand mark, no store name, no QR code, no membership or free-gift corner badge, no price, no contact details
no return-or-exchange policy, warranty years, eco grade or certificate stated as fact
no people, no hands and no visible faces; any reused figure must be anonymous and cropped

style.presentationRules: the cushion is the product and every seat is scenery: the pad keeps one thickness, the same panel division, the same edge finish, the same jacquard motif scale and repeat direction and the same cover tone in every frame, and the matching pillow keeps the same closure edge and motif placement; the pad lies flat and grounded with a real contact shadow and never floats or hovers above the seat; the anchor sofa keeps the same seat cushion count, the same open rectangular arm profile, the same leg shape and the same pale upholstery colour in every frame and always anchors human scale together with one second real furnishing; interior verticals, wall corners and seat lines stay straight and corrected; the slight 3/4 seated angle of the opening screen is reused on the closing screen so the set reads as one home
style.surfaceSystem: cool porcelain sweep #E3E7E4, matte micro-cement floor #C2C5C1, brushed matte pine plinth #14403C, clear acrylic riser, matte porcelain cards #F6F8F5, and one undyed linen anchor sofa #C4C7BF with a visible real weave; the product renders exactly as supplied, matte-faced jacquard brocade with satin sheen only inside the woven motif, cool pale woven reverse and a dotted anti-slip underside; no vinyl gloss, no leather, no plastic sheen
style.typography: one narrow humanist condensed sans family for Chinese display headlines set with open letterspacing over a 1px hairline double rule, the same family at regular weight for labels and in tabular figures for step numerals; headline 26-34pt, sub-line 14-16pt, labels 10-13pt, per-screen copy under 50 characters; all Chinese in-image copy wrapped in 「」; no serif, no brush calligraphy, no seal script, no heavy bold geometric face, no English uppercase kicker lines
